headline: US Sanctions Rwanda’s Defence Ministry Over Alleged M23 Support
summary: The US Treasury sanctioned Rwanda’s Defence Ministry and the Zigama savings society over alleged support for the M23 movement, while Rwanda denied backing the group.
why: Geopolitical sanctions imposed by the United States restrict financial access and commercial interactions for targeted foreign state entities and affiliated financial institutions.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: US sanctions target Rwanda's Defence Ministry and related entities.
